name: Cabbage Your Life
overview: When executive Seong Tae-hun is abruptly reassigned to the remote village of Yeonri‑ri, his family is thrown into rural chaos. Mi-ryeo struggles with farm life, Ji-cheon begins to rethink his future, and the wary village chief keeps his distance. As homesickness grows and tensions rise, the family must decide whether to endure—or find their way back home.
